title: Lytics Segment
description: Schema for a Lytics audience segment definition.

name.description: Human-readable display name for the segment

filter_ql.description: Lytics Query Language (LQL) expression that defines segment membership

size.description: Current count of users in this segment

created.description: Timestamp when the segment was created

modified.description: Timestamp when the segment was last modified

author_id.description: User ID of the account member who created the segment

public.description: Whether the segment is visible across accounts
